'''Terrorbirds''' (''Aves Terror'') are animals which are used by the [[gnomes]] as mounts. Despite their fearsome appearance, they are not aggressive at all. They are involved in the [[Rag and Bone Man]] [[quest]]. Terrorbirds count for the [[bird]] [[Slayer]] task.

==Trivia==
* The terrorbird is probably based on {{wp|Phorusrhacidae|Phorusrhacids}}, apex predators that lived during the Cenozoic Era, which are nicknamed "terror birds".
* Terrorbirds are likely poor climbers as referenced by a [[gnome trainer]] while proceeding to the advanced section of the [[Gnome Agility Course|agility course]]{{CiteNPC|npc=Gnome trainer|quote=Terrorbirds could climb faster than that!|loc=Gnome Agility Course}}.
